integrity: The proof supplies the infinite results; finite exhaustive checks are independent consistency evidence, not certification. No priority or independent verification is claimed.
limitations: Uniform independent partitions and classical finite S5 only; the sharp probability threshold is an asymptotic convergence without a quantitative rate. An equivalent more general random-covering result has not been ruled out; the closely related 2023 hypergraph article was not obtainable in full text.
title: Normality of multi-agent someone-knows: a partition census and Poisson agent threshold
